A welcome quest for anyone leaving the {wiki:Isle of Destiny}: it points you to five NPCs in Ankrahmun, Edron, Outlaw Camp, Thais and Venore, each with an easy quest and quick rewards. You earn 100 experience for each NPC you talk to (500 in total), and more rewards when you do their quests.

Loose Ends is a quest for characters who left the Isle of Destiny, created to show them easy quests with quick rewards. It is added to your quest log right after Captain Kurt takes you off the island, and it disappears once you have talked to all the NPCs.
Ahmet, Ankrahmun (can be done in any order)
Having left the Isle of Destiny with {npc:Captain Kurt} (the quest appears automatically in the quest log).
Money for boat trips between cities
100 experience for each NPC you talk to (500 in total)
More rewards when you complete each NPC's quests
You do not need to talk to any NPC to receive the 5 missions: the quest log is updated as soon as you leave the Isle of Destiny.
You can do the missions in **any order**. Once you have talked to the 5 NPCs, the Loose Ends quest disappears from the {wiki:Quest Log}.
To travel between cities use the boats: at the harbour, talk to the captain and say {key:hi}, the name of the city (for example {key:edron}) and {key:yes}.

Travel by boat to **Ankrahmun**: you arrive at the port of {npc:Captain Sinbeard}, who also takes you back. {npc:Ahmet} is **north** of the depot, **1 floor up**. Talk to him: this is where the {wiki:Steal from Thieves Quest} starts.

Travel by boat to **Edron** (you arrive at the port of {npc:Captain Seahorse}, who also takes you back) and go to the {wiki:Ivory Towers}, the seven ivory towers of the {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic} in the **east** part of the city. The central tower is the tallest (nine floors): go up to the top and talk to {npc:Spectulus}: this is where the {wiki:Sea of Light Quest} starts. To leave, go down the same stairs.
Central tower of the Ivory Towers

Go on foot to the {wiki:Outlaw Camp}, **east** of Thais and **west** of Venore (west of the Plains of Havoc). Follow the stone path to the main buildings: {npc:Rottin Wood} is in the **northernmost** building of the village. Talk to him: this is where the {wiki:Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest} starts. To leave, walk back to Thais (west) or Venore (east).
On the way and in the camp there are {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors} and {creature:Bandit|Bandits}.
Travel to **Thais** and go **south** to {npc:Eclesius}. Talk to him: this is where the {wiki:The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest} starts. You can also reach Eclesius from the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild}.
Travel to **Venore** and go **2 floors** up from the central depot. Talk to {npc:Boozer}: this is where {wiki:The Ultimate Booze Quest} starts.
After you talk to the 5 NPCs, the Loose Ends quest disappears from the quest log.
Along the way you may meet {creature:Snake|Snakes} and other creatures; in each NPC's quests you will find more.
